about: Boot unlock v2 (packages/protocol/src/bootUnlockV2.ts, pq-suites.md §19). Seeds are fixed; seals use the listed encapsulation randomness and signatures ML-DSA rnd = 0, so ports reproduce sealed bytes and the request signature exactly. 'accept-v1' means the policy lets the classical v1 opener run.
